dockerfile.amd64:
FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:ubunturesolute

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

# title
ENV TITLE="Ubuntu LXQt" \
    NO_FULL=true \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true \
    QT_AUTO_SCREEN_SCALE_FACTOR=0 \
    QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME=lxqt \
    XDG_CONFIG_DIRS=/etc:/etc/xdg:/usr/share \
    XDG_MENU_PREFIX=lxqt-

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/webtop-logo.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  add-apt-repository ppa:xtradeb/apps && \
  apt-get update && \
  DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive \
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y \
    adwaita-icon-theme \
    breeze-icon-theme \
    chromium \
    featherpad \
    gtk-update-icon-cache \
    gvfs \
    gvfs-daemons \
    kimageformat6-plugins \
    layer-shell-qt \
    libgtk-3-common \
    libqt6multimedia6 \
    libqt6svg6 \
    libqt6svgwidgets6 \
    libqt6widgets6 \
    libusb-1.0-0 \
    lximage-qt \
    lxqt-about \
    lxqt-about-l10n \
    lxqt-config \
    lxqt-config-l10n \
    lxqt-menu-data \
    lxqt-notificationd \
    lxqt-notificationd-l10n \
    lxqt-panel \
    lxqt-panel-l10n \
    lxqt-policykit \
    lxqt-policykit-l10n \
    lxqt-qtplugin \
    lxqt-runner \
    lxqt-runner-l10n \
    lxqt-session \
    lxqt-session-l10n \
    obconf-qt \
    obconf-qt-l10n \
    pavucontrol-qt \
    pcmanfm-qt \
    pcmanfm-qt-l10n \
    qt6-image-formats-plugins \
    qt6-svg-plugins \
    qt6-wayland \
    qterminal \
    qterminal-l10n \
    xdg-desktop-portal-lxqt && \
  echo "**** selkies theme ****" && \
  mkdir -p \
    /tmp/theme \
    /usr/share/lxqt/themes/selkies \
    /usr/share/themes/Selkies/openbox-3 \
    /usr/share/qtermwidget6/color-schemes && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/selkies.tar.gz -L \
    "https://github.com/selkies-project/selkies/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz" && \
  tar xf \
    /tmp/selkies.tar.gz -C \
    /tmp/theme --strip-components=4 --wildcards '*/addons/desktop/theme/*' && \
  cp -a /tmp/theme/lxqt/. /usr/share/lxqt/themes/selkies/ && \
  cp -a /tmp/theme/openbox/. /usr/share/themes/Selkies/openbox-3/ && \
  cp /tmp/theme/qterminal/Selkies.colorscheme /usr/share/qtermwidget6/color-schemes/ && \
  sed -i \
    -e '0,/<name>[^<]*<\/name>/s||<name>Selkies</name>|' \
    -e 's|<titleLayout>NLMC</titleLayout>|<titleLayout>NLIMC</titleLayout>|' \
    /etc/xdg/openbox/rc.xml && \
  sed -i \
    -e 's|<name>Clearlooks</name>|<name>Selkies</name>|' \
    -e 's|<cornerRadius>8</cornerRadius>|&\n    <dropShadows>yes</dropShadows>|' \
    /defaults/labwc.xml && \
  sed -i \
    's|^Icon=.*|Icon=/usr/share/lxqt/themes/selkies/filemanager.svg|' \
    /usr/share/applications/pcmanfm-qt.desktop && \
  echo "**** lxqt tweaks ****" && \
  sed -i \
    's#^Exec=.*#Exec=/usr/local/bin/wrapped-chromium#g' \
    /usr/share/applications/chromium.desktop && \
  mv \
    /usr/bin/chromium \
    /usr/bin/chromium-browser && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get autoclean && \
  rm -rf \
    /config/.cache \
    /config/.launchpadlib \
    /tmp/* \
    /usr/share/applications/lxqt-config-monitor.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/lxqt-hibernate.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/lxqt-leave.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/lxqt-lockscreen.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/lxqt-logout.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/lxqt-reboot.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/lxqt-shutdown.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/lxqt-suspend.desktop \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3001
VOLUME /config
